summary: Phase C Community Leadership Program (PARAS REWARD, Feb 15 2026 rename) end-to-end test. Seeded a 5-tier synthetic tree (1 NATIONAL → 5 STATE → 15 REGIONAL → 75 DISTRICT → 100+ L1 members plus a partial-72 district, a 1200-leaf FIFO district, a CH-strict test district, and a Community Member). Verified all Phase C additions on GET /api/partners/my-position/{uid} — labels, cap, hierarchy_score_pct, community_health block, next_promotion block. Verified Community Health strict-active definition (Elite+collect<=7d) with green/yellow/red/gray thresholds. Verified admin assign/revoke via X-Admin-Pin uses new 'District Coordinator' label + Leadership Reward notification (NOT 'commission'). Verified mining_referral_reward notification title '🎉 Leadership Reward Received!' and 'Tier X Leadership Reward' message. minor.issue: FIFO reward-ceiling ordering (docstring at partner_positions.py L15: 'only the earliest-position cap-many count') is NOT implemented in mining_commission.distribute_mining_collect_commission — cap is not enforced by counting L1s in created_at order; any position-tier upline at valid hop receives full 1% regardless of downline count > cap. Test xfail flagged.

Playwright inner_text() on [data-testid=community-health-status] returned 'JUST STARTING' (backend text from /api/community/dashboard), but the Phase C code at ReferralsEnhanced.js L825-829 maps status→Healthy/Average/Needs Attention/No Data. Possible duplicate testid across two components. Needs main-agent review.

phase_c_ui_hidden_bug.symptom: Phase C UI widgets (partner-position-label, Reward Ceiling Usage progress bar, next-promotion-tracker) not visible on /referrals for Elite user with position=user.
phase_c_ui_hidden_bug.root_cause: ReferralsEnhanced.js line 81 called `${API}/partners/my-position/${uid}` — missing the /api/ prefix. Kubernetes ingress routes only /api/* to backend; other paths return the SPA index.html. axios.get succeeded (HTTP 200) but the body was HTML, so positionRes.data.success was undefined and `if (positionRes?.data?.success)` never populated partnerPosition state.
phase_c_ui_hidden_bug.reproduction: 1. Login as Elite user with position=user. 2. Visit /referrals. 3. Scroll — no Reward Ceiling / next promotion / partner label. 4. Open DevTools Network — call to /partners/my-position/{uid} returns index.html with content-type text/html.
phase_c_ui_hidden_bug.mitigation: Added /api/ prefix on ReferralsEnhanced.js L81. Verified after fix: all 8 Phase C testids render with correct labels and values.

fifo_cap_missing.symptom: 1200th leaf's mining collect propagated to DISTRICT upline; spec says only earliest 1000 should count.
fifo_cap_missing.root_cause: mining_commission.py distribute_mining_collect_commission never filters by L1 rank/order — it walks upline once per hop and pays every valid position holder.
fifo_cap_missing.mitigation: Not fixed by testing agent (business logic). Test is xfail-marked with reason pointing to partner_positions.py L15 doc-only claim.
